name: Should I purchase my own bathroom fixtures or have the contractor provide them?

mainEntity.name: Should I purchase my own bathroom fixtures or have the contractor provide them?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can supply your own fixtures, or your contractor can source them for you. If you choose to purchase your own faucets, shower systems, or vanities, ensure all compatible rough-in valves, drain kits, and mounting hardware are included in the order. Incompatible valves or missing internal cartridges are frequent causes of project downtime. A contractor can evaluate your product specifications beforehand to verify they match your existing pipe sizing, wall depth, and local plumbing rough-ins before installation day.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can purchase your own fixtures, but ensure rough-in valves and drain assemblies are included. A contractor can review specifications first to confirm compatibility.
